verdict.rationale: Ramp ships some built-in recurring automations (auto top-up with target-balance thresholds, hotel rate monitoring with auto-rebooking) and exposes an API/MCP server/CLI that an AI-native user could theoretically use to build scheduled jobs, but there is no evidence of a general-purpose 'schedule recurring workflow' feature or API endpoint for arbitrary AI-driven jobs.  Missing for 10: documented job-scheduling API/cron-like capability, evidence of AI agents actually creating custom recurring workflows via MCP/CLI, and independent confirmation of this automation depth.
